description: This file defines a CacheControlAdapter class that extends the requests.adapters.HTTPAdapter to support caching mechanisms within HTTP requests, handling cache validation, cache updates, response wrapping, and invalidation logic. It is part of the pip package vendor's cachecontrol module, providing HTTP caching functionality.

classes.description: A specialized HTTPAdapter that manages HTTP caching behavior, including cache validation, cache control, heuristics, and cache invalidation within the requests library.
